vb.f: (physical chemistry, countable) Initialism of valence bond.

s.g: (medicine) A vaginal birth undertaken with precautionary measures subsequent to a cesarean section birth.
s.x: I was worried about having a VBAC because my mother nearly bled to death when she gave live birth to me after having had a cesarean.

vbg.f: (Internet slang) Abbreviation of very big grin; often enclosed in * * or < > to indicate that the user is grinning very widely.

vbied.f: (military, US) Initialism of vehicle-borne improvised explosive device.

vbo.f: (computer graphics, OpenGL) Initialism of vertex buffer object.
